daily.today_energy: With Mars and Jupiter conjunct in Leo, there's major energy pushing you to take action, but the Sun squaring both creates internal friction. Your ruling planet Pluto is watching from the shadows—use this tension to transform something that's been stuck.
daily.love: Venus in Libra is playing peacemaker while you're in intensity mode. If you're coupled up, this is actually good for conversations you've been avoiding. Single? Your magnetic pull is strong, but don't mistake attention for connection.
daily.career: Mars-Jupiter conjunction has everyone feeling bold, but Sun square Mars means your moves need strategy, not just speed. Mercury in Scorpio keeps you sharp—trust your instincts on what people aren't saying out loud.
daily.health: That Aries Moon wants action, but Saturn retrograde is asking you to slow down. Great day for intentional movement like weight training or focused stretching rather than chaos cardio. Rest isn't laziness.

weekly.overview: This week is intense for you, Scorpio. The Sun Square Mars (early week) has you fired up but potentially scattered—channel that heat into ONE priority. The Full Moon in Gemini (late week) illuminates communication and contracts. Best Day: Thursday. Watch-Out Day: Tuesday when Mars Conjunction Jupiter amplifies everything to 11.
weekly.love: Venus Sextile Jupiter mid-week is your golden ticket for romance or deepening existing connections. If you've been holding back, this transit softens your usual intensity and makes vulnerability feel safe. Single? Someone's noticing. Already coupled? Plan something meaningful.
weekly.career: Sun Square Mars creates friction between your ego and action—resist the urge to steamroll. By Thursday, the Full Moon brings clarity on projects or partnerships. This is when you see which collaborations are actually worth your energy. Trust your gut on who's real.
weekly.health: The Moon Trine Mars Thursday boosts physical energy—perfect for workouts or movement you've been postponing. Early week might feel mentally restless though. Meditation or journaling helps. Stay hydrated; this intensity is draining.
